package dailyassignments;

public class AreaOfShapePolymorphism {
	static double calculateArea(double pi, int radius)
	{
		return pi * radius * radius;
	}

	static int calculateArea(int length, int breadth)
	{		
		return length * breadth;
	}
	
	
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
					
		/*
		 * 1. Overload the calculateArea(int radius) method for circle 
			2. Overload the calculateArea(int length,int breadth) method for rectangle 
			Formulas:
			- Circle: Area = 3.14 Ã— radius Ã— radius
			- Rectangle: Area = length Ã— breadth
		 */
		
		double area = calculateArea(3.14, 5);
		System.out.println("Area of circle: "+area);
		
		int area1 = calculateArea(8, 4);
		System.out.println("Area of rectangle: "+area1);
				
	}

}
